ActorTalk: Hello, Gray Raven Commandant. Can I ask you a question?
I've been doing simulated combat recently, trying to achieve the best results possible in classic battle simulations.
But it hasn't been going well, so I wanted to ask—in your eyes, what's the one thing that we should absolutely believe in and uphold when we're on the battlefield?
Trusting your comrades... means letting them handle what you're not good at, right?
But that would mean admitting my own weakness... I'll give it a try anyway.
Believe in myself, huh... So, when you're on the battlefield, what's really important is confidence and morale—is that what you're saying?
It's true. I'm often hesitant and afraid to make decisions.
Next time... I'll believe in myself more. Thank you.
Wait... huh? So the power of money was the secret to your winning streak all along?
Although it'll be a bit difficult... starting today, I'll work more part-time jobs...
